title: Implement audit baseline
final_head_policy: The exact final pushed PR head and exact-head GitHub Actions runs are recorded in the PR/final handoff; later pushes invalidate earlier CI evidence.

branch_protection.note: Legacy branch-protection GET returned integration HTTP 403; repository ruleset GET succeeded and is the proof source. No platform mutation was necessary because enforcement was already active at first observation.

implementation.append_only_control: BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger rejects ordinary mutation
implementation.server_authority: PostgreSQL generates event UUID/time; canonical Account/Organization rows and membership resolve scope; metadata cannot override authority fields
implementation.ordering: occurred_at DESC, id DESC with a composite cursor
implementation.write_surface: narrow server-only authentication and authorization recorder methods; no generic client create API

authentication_session: session.created is inserted transactionally by PostgreSQL after identity_sessions insert
session.revoked is inserted transactionally before identity_sessions delete
attributable invalid-credential attempts record authentication.login_failed against the canonical subject Account with a null actor
unknown email attempts are not promoted to canonical Account authority and are not persisted in the account-scoped ledger
authorization: registered organization decisions record authorization.<action> allow/deny
canonical actor and existing Organization scope are server-resolved
unknown UUID resources remain account-scoped evidence
required allow audit write failure returns audit_unavailable and fails closed
denials remain denied if audit storage is unavailable

security.reads: authenticated account must equal requested account; organization-filtered reads also require current canonical membership
security.metadata: plain bounded JSON only; authority-shaped keys rejected; secret-named keys omitted; secret-looking values redacted

capability_status.rationale: The production-direction durable baseline and deterministic local tests exist. VERIFIED/COMPLETE are not claimed before exact-head PostgreSQL CI and independent acceptance.

results.postgresql_live: NOT EXECUTED locally because DATABASE_URL is absent; never represented as a pass

known_limitations: No Project authority or Project-scoped audit before M-012.
No organization-admin/role-based audit catalog; baseline reads are account-private.
Unknown-email and un-attributable malformed/revoked-token attempts have no canonical account scope and are not inserted into this ledger.
No SIEM export, OpenTelemetry platform, analytics, activity feed, cryptographic non-repudiation, or long-term retention controls.
Audit metadata redaction is defense in depth; narrow typed producers and no raw payload dumping remain the primary control.
overclaim_check: M-011 is REVIEW, not DONE. VF-IAM-004 is IMPLEMENTED, not VERIFIED or COMPLETE. PostgreSQL is not claimed locally. M-012 remains LOCKED.
